description: A small-business filer's revenue reaches its own position in the cash-basis statement. This is the combination the de pack exists for — someone taxed under the small-business scheme almost always determines profit on a cash basis — and until 2026-08-23 it was the one combination the pack got wrong: account 4040 (small-business revenue) appeared in NO position of `de-euer`, because E1 covers 4000–4019 by range and 4040 sits outside it. The money did not vanish (a cash-basis position falls back to the account name), but it landed outside every official line of the form, silently: unlike the income statement, the cash-basis projection has no gap warning. Three fixtures existed around this and none could see it — `de-kleinunternehmer` posts to 4040 but only checks the trial balance, and `de-euer` checks the statement but never touches 4040. The pack now carries E5 for it, and `PackCompletenessTest` fails if any shipped account loses its position again.

expect.comment: Beide Konten tragen jetzt eine amtliche Position statt ihres Kontonamens: 4040 die eigene Zeile für Kleinunternehmer-Einnahmen, 6020 die nicht abziehbaren Betriebsausgaben.
